summary: A period chosen under "Stored at" is now kept when values are pasted in before the first save.
details: Setting a hand-entered triangle to keep its figures monthly under a yearly view, pasting a 10x10 block and saving once now stores it monthly, as ResQ does, instead of moving the store up to the yearly view.
The "Stored at" control now stays open until the dataset is saved with a value in it, rather than closing as soon as something is typed or pasted.
This matters when the dataset is sent back to ResQ, which can only show the right column ages for a triangle kept at the finer period.
